title: 第1578章 楚湘灵 夫君要钻研钻研吗第1577章 冰清种情丹北君的计划
slug: 自缚禁地五百年我当散修你哭啥
content_zh:
原本有些干瘪的嘴唇，变得丰盈可口，原本稍稍低了一些的眼角，也在悄无声息之间提高了几分。
她在变美！
不是凭空变成另外一个人，而是将她全身上下各处，变得更加完美，更加无可挑剔起来。
仅仅只是盏茶功夫，原本已经算得上美丽动人的温雅，越发趋向于完美。
如凝脂玉般的肌肤，恰到好处的精致五官，盈盈一握的腰身，浑身上下，从骨到皮，都充斥着恰到好处的美感，挑不出半点毛病。
“北君大人，您看……奴家现在怎么样了？”
温雅话刚出口，便忍不住吃惊了起来，她发现自己就连声音都多了一些变化，更加悦耳柔和了。
北君也愣了愣神，上上下下打量了温雅一阵后，点头道：“很好，非常好。”
这番称赞让温雅心中一喜。
没有人不喜欢自己变得更漂亮更美丽，虽说修行本就能让人延年益寿，青春永驻，气质也更加突出，但也没法从根源上去改变一个人的相貌。
虽说有变化之术能让人变幻形貌。
可那终究是假的，是要依靠手段维持的，是能够被人识破的。
但现在，这冰清钟情丹，却让温雅真正意义上从骨到皮全面改变了样貌。
特别是这改变后的样貌，让北君都有些发愣的时候，更让她心中激动不已。
只是很快，这份激动化作苦涩。
北君似乎对她真的一点兴趣都没有，哪怕如今的自己至少外形上已经无可挑剔的完美了，可北君也只是诧异了片刻便恢复如常。
眼神中更没有半点情欲之色。
“你现在的这副容貌，已经不比那楚湘灵差了，现在告诉我，你还有信心把顾修勾引走吗？”
再次面对这个问题，温雅显然自信了很多，她神采奕奕地点头：“我一定不会让北君您失望的！”
……

对于北君的计划，顾修和楚湘灵并不清楚，他们正兴致勃勃地参观着接下来要住的这座顶层别院。
推开冰晶雕琢的月洞门，眼前豁然出现一方露天的庭院。
庭院中积雪盈尺，却有几株不知名的银白色矮树破雪而生，枝头缀着细碎的冰花，在不知从何处透来的微光下，折射出星星点点的暖色光晕。
更妙的，是庭院尽头还有一眼冒着热气的温泉。
水汽氤氲上升，在半空中凝成细雪又簌簌落下，循环往复，仿佛这一方小小天地自成一个四季轮回的幻境。
这里和下方那种肃杀压抑截然不同，站在顶楼，甚至能够眺望城外远方的雪景。
“夫君，这院子竟有温泉！”
楚湘灵松开顾修的胳膊，像一只乍然归林的雀鸟，提着裙摆小跑到池边蹲下身探了探水温，眉眼弯弯的赞叹道：“想不到这北君，还挺会享受的。”
顾修也有些诧异，走到那温泉面前查探了一番：
“这别院应该是专为贵客准备的，而且这温泉并非寻常温泉，其中源力、灵力甚至还有圣芒之力，对此界修士的修行有益。”
“而且若是之前一路我没看错的话，这温泉应当是借助此地地势，又辅佐阵法特地设置的，以凛冬城的格局，类似这样的温泉最多只有两处。”
“夫君连这都看出来了？”
楚湘灵眼睛瞪得老大，满是崇拜。
这眼神还别说，顾修感觉挺受用。
可很快，就听楚湘灵语气一转，贴了上来：“夫君观察凛冬城观察得这么仔细，怎么不好好观察观察妾身呢？”
说着，她抬起纤纤玉指，特意拂过那白玉锁骨：“这温泉养人，妾身方才蹲那片刻，皮肤都润了不少呢，夫君要不要摸摸看？”
她说这话的时候眼睛亮晶晶的，带着一种明知对方会害羞却偏要逗他的促狭。
顾修果然僵了一瞬，干咳一声，目光笔直地越过她头顶望向远处的屋檐：“你若是冷了，去泡一泡便是。
我看那边有书房，刚好我先和圣城那边联系联系，这几日不在，想来应当也积累了不少政务。”
说罢，顾修逃也似的快步离去。

楚湘灵站在原地，看着他几乎同手同脚的背影，掩着唇笑得肩膀直抖。
不过她倒也没追上去，只是在后面扬声道：“夫君别忙太晚，妾身泡完了给夫君暖一壶酒送过去。”
书房的门“啪”
content_en:
The originally dry lips became plump and delicious, and the corners of the eyes, which were originally lowered slightly, also quietly improved a bit.
She is becoming beautiful!
It's not that she becomes another person out of thin air, but that every part of her body becomes more perfect and impeccable.
With just a cup of tea, Wen Ya, who was already beautiful and moving, became more and more perfect.
Skin like jade, just the right delicate facial features, a waist that can be grasped, the whole body, from bones to skin, is full of just the right beauty, and there is no fault at all.
"Lord Beijun, do you think...how is the slave family doing now?"
As soon as Wen Ya's words came out of her mouth, she couldn't help but be surprised. She found that even her voice had some changes, becoming more pleasant and softer.
Beijun was also stunned. After looking at Wen Ya up and down for a while, he nodded and said, "Very good, very good."
This compliment made Wen Ya feel happy.
No one likes to become prettier and more beautiful. Although spiritual practice can extend one's life, stay youthful forever, and make one's temperament more outstanding, it cannot fundamentally change a person's appearance.
Although there is a transformation technique that can change people's appearance.
But after all, it is a lie, it must be maintained by means, and it can be seen through by others.
But now, this Bingqing Love Pill has completely changed Wen Ya's appearance from bone to skin.
Especially this changed appearance, which even made Beijun a little dazed, made her even more excited.
But soon, this excitement turned into bitterness.
Beijun didn't seem to be interested in her at all. Even though he was now impeccable in appearance, Beijun was only surprised for a moment before returning to normal.
There was no trace of lust in his eyes.
"Your current appearance is no worse than that of Chu Xiangling. Now tell me, do you still have the confidence to seduce Gu Xiu away?"
Facing this problem again, Wen Ya obviously felt much more confident. She nodded energetically: "I will definitely not let you down, Beijun!"
…
Gu Xiu and Chu Xiangling were not clear about Beijun's plan. They were happily visiting the top-floor courtyard where they would live next.
Pushing open the moon cave door carved with ice crystals, an open-air courtyard suddenly appeared in front of you.
There is a lot of snow in the courtyard, but there are a few unknown silver-white dwarf trees growing through the snow. The branches are decorated with fine ice flowers. Under the dim light coming from nowhere, they reflect the warm halo of stars.
Even better, there is a steaming hot spring at the end of the courtyard.
The water vapor rises thickly, condenses into fine snow in mid-air, and then falls again, repeating the cycle, as if this small world has become an illusion of four seasons.
This place is completely different from the chilling and oppressive atmosphere below. Standing on the top floor, you can even look out at the snowy scenery in the distance outside the city.
"Husband, there is a hot spring in this courtyard!"
Chu Xiangling let go of Gu Xiu's arm, like a bird suddenly returning to the forest, holding up the hem of her skirt and trotting to the edge of the pool, squatting down to check the water temperature, and exclaimed with a crooked eyebrow: "I didn't expect that this Beijun would really enjoy it."
Gu Xiu was also a little surprised and walked to the hot spring to investigate:
"This villa should be specially prepared for distinguished guests, and this hot spring is not an ordinary hot spring. It contains source power, spiritual power and even the power of the Holy Light, which is beneficial to the practice of monks in this world."
"And if I read it correctly, this hot spring should be specially set up with the help of the terrain and the formation. With the layout of Winter City, there are only two hot springs like this at most."
"Husband, have you even noticed this?"
Chu Xiangling's eyes widened with admiration.
Not to mention this look, Gu Xiu felt that it was quite helpful.
But soon, she heard Chu Xiangling's tone change and she said, "My husband observes Winter City so carefully, why don't you observe me carefully?"
Talking, she raised her slender jade fingers and brushed the white jade collarbone specifically: "This hot spring nourishes people. The moment I squatted just now, my skin was moisturized a lot. Husband, do you want to touch it?"
Her eyes were bright when she said this, with a kind of narrow-mindedness that she knew the other person would be shy but wanted to tease him.
Sure enough, Gu Xiu froze for a moment, coughed dryly, and looked directly over her head at the eaves in the distance: "If you are cold, just go take a dip.
I saw there was a study over there, so I happened to contact the Holy City first. Since I have been away for the past few days, I must have accumulated a lot of government affairs. "
After saying that, Gu Xiu left quickly as if running away.
Chu Xiangling stood there, looking at his back with almost the same hands and feet, covering her lips and laughing so hard that her shoulders shook.
However, she didn't catch up. She just raised her voice from behind and said, "Husband, don't be too late. When I'm done soaking, I'll warm a pot of wine for my husband and send it over."
The study door clicked
